ctx.x: I've heard that name. Faith, what is his name? I don't know whether he's going to see. Somebody played with... He played with Bill Johnson in them, too. I think he's played with Ice Can Tate, too. He played with Bill Johnson in them out there, I think, too. Really? I've never met him. Bill Johnson's been to California again, they tell me. I haven't seen Bill Johnson in the middle. Is he back now? Yeah, he's back now. I haven't got to see. He said a man can't get a job in California if he don't belong to that…

He's such a friendly fellow. What is his address? I don't know for sure. I have it at home. I'll try to find it. Yeah? I'll make a note of it right now. Yeah. I have it at home. Unless he's moved. I haven't seen him for about six or seven years. I see. Well, he was supposed to come here this winter. There was one trumpet player, a white kid, who had a band. And when he left Ory, he was going to get him to come here in June. But Garland didn't come with him. Oh, I guess. Maybe June. Because he didn't want to…

What do you do? Well, take care of yourself. You know, man, don't run around too much and getting drunk, laying out in the snow. That ain't no good. No, that's true. I saw some nice musicians. I had to clap. It was a shame. You haven't lost your hair, no gray hair or anything? No. Well, that's just to keep up. See? I don't drink at all. I lost all of my hair. Well, some people do lose their hair early, you know. Yeah, that's right. And a lot of people just keep their hair a long time before they, you know,…
